seo.title: Boots: machine learning personalized Advantage Card offers - 23.9% redemption and +3.2% spend (2023)
seo.meta_description: Boots uses machine learning to score its Advantage Card members' propensity for each offer: 23.9% redemption, +3.2% spend vs a control group.
seo.resume_citable: Boots' personalized quarterly mailing, where a machine learning model scores each Advantage Card holder's propensity to use each offer, reached 23.9% redemption and +3.2% incremental spend against a control group.

faq.q: How does Boots personalize its Advantage Card offers?
faq.a: A machine learning model scores, for each member, the probability of using each offer, and keeps only the most relevant ones in the quarterly mailing and the app, measured against a control group.

faq.q: What results did the personalization produce?
faq.a: An average redemption rate of 23.9%, 2.4 coupons redeemed in-store per member, and 3.2% higher spend compared to the control group.

pattern: machine learning scoring of offer-usage propensity, applied to mail and the app
objectif_business: Increase Advantage Card holders' spend and engagement by sending each member only the offers they are most likely to use, measured against a control group to prove the incremental effect.
description: Boots leverages the data from its Advantage Card program, which has on the order of 15 million active users. For its quarterly mailing, a machine learning model scores the probability that each member will use each potential offer, and keeps only the most relevant ones for the personalized mail sent to the household. The setup is measured against a control group to isolate the incremental effect. The personalized offers reached an average redemption rate of 23.9%, with 2.4 coupons redeemed in-store per member on average. Compared to the control, the addressed population spent 3.2% more. The mailing also generated 2,745 incremental sign-ups to the Over 60s club and 18,583 incremental app downloads across four sends. In parallel, the Price Advantage personalized pricing setup saved customers more than 12 million pounds.
points_cles: Personalized quarterly mailing: an ML model scores each member's propensity for each offer.
Based on the Advantage Card history (15 million active), mail production with Marketreach.
23.9% redemption, +3.2% incremental spend vs control, 18,583 app downloads.
Evidence level B, confirmed active status.

resultats.metrique: Average redemption rate of the personalized offers
Customer savings generated by Price Advantage personalized pricing

niveau_preuve.justification: Award-winning case study (DMA Awards 2023) documenting a machine learning model and an incremental measurement against a control group, with precise figures. Corroborated by an established press source (CX Network) on the scale of the program and the Price Advantage setup.

stack_technique.detail: Machine learning model that scores, for each member, the probability of using each candidate offer; the exact algorithm is not named in the sources.
Purchase history of about 15 million active users, fuel for the scoring and for tying redemption back to the member.
Physical mail partner: production and sending of the personalized quarterly mailing per household.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Quarterly for the mailing, with offer scoring ahead of each send
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Boots' customer marketing team, supported by data and the mail partner Marketreach
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The purchase history of each Advantage Card holder. Without it, the propensity model cannot sort the offers, and the mailing reverts to a generic send with no measurable incremental effect.

etapes.detail: Marketing defines the pool of candidate offers and brands for the quarter.
The machine learning model scores, for each member, the probability of using each offer.
Only the highest-probability offers are kept and printed in the household mailing.
The mail goes out, and the addressed population is compared to a control group on redemption and spend.

prerequis_data: purchase history of the card holders
pool of offers and brands to arbitrate
ability to tie redemption back to the member
prerequis_orga: loyalty program with usable postal addresses
test protocol with a control group
replication.premiere_etape: Build an offer-propensity model on the card holders' history and test it on a mailing with a control group.

playbook.action: Define the quarter's universe of offers and brands and extract the purchase history per member from the loyalty program.
playbook.livrable: Member x offer dataset ready for scoring.

playbook.action: Train the propensity model and validate it offline: lift of the score-based selection against a random selection.
playbook.livrable: Model with a documented lift curve.

playbook.action: Build the mail personalization chain with the print partner: only the highest-probability offers are printed per household.
Send to a test population with a control group drawn at random before the send.
playbook.livrable: Campaign sent, incremental measurement plan locked.

playbook.action: Measure redemption and incremental spend against the control, then retrain the model with the observed redemptions.
playbook.livrable: Quantified incremental assessment and updated model.

replication.equipe: 1 data scientist + 1 CRM/loyalty lead + the mail partner for production and sending.

statut_vivant.note: Boots continues to invest in Advantage Card personalization, with a new step announced for 2026 on app-targeted offers. The machine learning component of the mailing is documented for 2023.

transposable_ue.note: The case is already European (United Kingdom). The individual scoring of the propensity to use an offer relies on the purchase history of card holders. Even outside the EU post-Brexit, an equivalent setup in the EU requires a legal basis and GDPR consent for marketing profiling. Personalized mailing is not high-risk under the AI Act.
